text:
ana (Partnerships): Quick idea: a compact "commit-bridge" marketplace offer tying HW rebates + SI activation credits to a clear conversion path to Dedicated. Need fast feedback on commit floors and credit rules.
ben (Sales): sounds promising. what's the min commit? and AE quota mapping?
ana (Partnerships): draft: Intro = 60d, $15k min, 30% off, $2k onboarding credit. Commit = 12mo, $20k min, 18% off, $1k onboarding, HW rebate up to $6k redeemable only against Reserved/Dedicated SKUs. Credits don't stack.
zhou (Product): UI notes: show "Intro price" and "Renewal guidance" rows; add tooltip explaining rebate redemption window (180d) and SKU mapping requirement.
mira (Finance): flag: onboarding credits amortized over the committed term; rebates issued as capacity credits after purchase verification. I'll run ARR impact.
kai (Solutions): SI activation credit ($1.5k) after checklist (integration runbook + test harness). Credit blocks stacking with customer onboarding credit.
ops (Eng): ops: entitlement flags, pricing mask staging, billing-hook smoke tests, and telemetry for credit redemptions. can validate Wed AM.
legal-bot: Reminder: LOA required T-8 business days pre-announce; partner quote signoff 3 business days.
ben (Sales): renewal sweetener idea: renew >=110% commit -> extend discount by 3ppt. also convert-to-dedicated within 6mo -> return 50% of onboarding credit as capacity credit.
ana (Partnerships): action owners: Ana finalize doc (Tue), Mira ARR model (Thu), Kai SI checklist (Fri), Ops validate (Wed), Legal push LOA template. Any objections? :rocket:
